newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Ingwe rises on good year results.
newsitem.headline: Ingwe rises on good year results.

text.p: Good year results fuelled shares in South African firm Ingwe Coal Corp Ltd on Tuesday, dealers said.
By about 0838 GMT Ingwe was up 15 cents at 24.20 rand with volumes traded at just over one million rand.
"Ingwe had good results and they were in line with what was expected," a dealer at the Johannesburg Stock Exchange said.
The company announced earnings per share up at 320.0 cents from 234.0 cents previously. Ingwe hiked its dividend for the period to 150.0 cents compared with 110.0 cents a year ago.
A Reuters consensus poll of analysts had forecast Ingwe's earnings per share rising by 41 percent to 329 cents from a previous 234 cents. The range was between 310-350 cents.
Dealers said the share was also buoyed by Ingwe's forecast it should achieve similar results for the year to June 30, 1998.
The share earlier touched a day's high of 24.25 rand.
